Title: Perfect Dictation
Explanation: Awarded for the first time you achieve 100% accuracy on a dictation question.

Title: Perfect Repetition
Explanation: Awarded for the first time you achieve 100% pronunciation score on a question.

Title: First Light
Description: First practice attempt of the day
Explanation: Earned by completing your first practice attempt of the day.

Title: Tic Tac Toe, Three In A Row
Explanation: Awarded for practicing consecutively for 3 days.

Title: Level Up: Completed
Description: Reach Completed tier for a question
Explanation: Reached 'Completed' status (3 perfect attempts) for a single question.

Title: Level Up: Consolidated
Description: Reach Consolidated tier for a question
Explanation: Reached 'Consolidated' status (6 perfect attempts) for a single question.

Title: Level Up: Mastered
Description: Reach Mastered tier for a question
Explanation: Reached 'Mastered' status (9 perfect attempts) for a single question.
